options_evaluated: Virgin ABS plastic with internal ribbing
decisions.trade_off: Balancing mechanical durability and impact resistance (to prevent premature product failure) against the carbon footprint of raw material extraction and end-of-life recyclability.
decisions.rationale: PCR PC/ABS offers high impact resistance necessary for a vacuum cleaner (which is frequently bumped into walls) while significantly reducing the carbon footprint compared to virgin plastics, and it remains highly recyclable at end-of-life compared to bio-composites which can contaminate existing recycling streams.
decisions.design_action: Verify the supply chain consistency and mechanical property tolerances of PCR PC/ABS grades from local suppliers to ensure they meet minimum impact strength requirements.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal fasteners with brass inserts
Snap-fits integrated into the housing with reversible screw fasteners
decisions.trade_off: Assembly speed and structural sealing integrity versus ease of disassembly for repair, recycling, and material separation at end-of-life.
decisions.recommendation: Snap-fits integrated into the housing with reversible screw fasteners
decisions.rationale: This hybrid approach allows for toolless access to common wear items (like filters) via snap-fits, while using standard, reversible screws for structural joints. This avoids permanent bonding (like ultrasonic welding) which prevents recycling, and avoids molded-in brass inserts which complicate polymer recycling.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the disassembly guidelines (e.g., VDI 2243) to check if the proposed snap-fit locations allow non-destructive access using standard workshop tools.

options_evaluated: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with neodymium magnets
decisions.trade_off: Energy efficiency and motor lifespan versus the environmental impact of mining rare-earth elements (neodymium) and the complexity of controller electronics.
decisions.recommendation: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with neodymium magnets
decisions.rationale: Although neodymium mining has high environmental impacts, the BLDC motor's superior energy efficiency (reducing use-phase emissions, which dominate a vacuum's LCA) and significantly longer lifespan (no brushes to wear out) outweigh the initial material extraction impacts over the product's lifecycle.
decisions.design_action: Check the availability of BLDC motor suppliers who offer certified recycled neodymium magnets or magnet-recovery programs.

options_evaluated: Active cooling fan integrated on the motor shaft
Passive heat sinking using extruded aluminum fins
Forced-air cooling utilizing the primary vacuum intake airflow
decisions.trade_off: Added material weight and complexity of dedicated cooling components versus the risk of motor overheating and reduced efficiency if intake airflow is restricted (e.g., full dust bag).
decisions.recommendation: Forced-air cooling utilizing the primary vacuum intake airflow
decisions.rationale: Utilizing the working airflow for motor cooling eliminates the need for an auxiliary fan or heavy aluminum heat sinks, reducing overall product weight and material intensity. It maximizes energy efficiency by dual-purposing the aerodynamic work already being done.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the thermal limits of the motor under a 'blocked nozzle' scenario to verify if a secondary thermal bypass valve is conceptually required to prevent overheating.

options_evaluated: Modular cartridge system (separate motor, battery, and dust-cyclone modules)
Semi-modular layout with wired internal connections
decisions.trade_off: Increased initial material use and volume (due to extra walls and connectors in modules) versus ease of consumer repair, component upgrading, and closed-loop recycling.
decisions.recommendation: Modular cartridge system (separate motor, battery, and dust-cyclone modules)
decisions.rationale: A modular cartridge system allows users to easily replace the battery or motor—the two most common failure points—without discarding the entire appliance. This significantly extends the product's useful life, offsetting the minor increase in initial manufacturing impact.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the spatial requirements and connector standards needed to ensure the modules can be separated without damaging internal wiring or seals.

options_evaluated: Removable Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) battery pack
decisions.trade_off: Unlimited runtime and lower manufacturing footprint (no battery) versus user convenience, battery degradation, and the toxicity/resource depletion of battery chemistry.
decisions.recommendation: Removable Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) battery pack
decisions.rationale: While corded power has the lowest environmental footprint, market demand strongly favors cordless. Among cordless options, LFP chemistry offers a significantly longer cycle life (2000+ cycles vs. 500 for traditional Li-ion) and avoids the use of cobalt and nickel, greatly reducing toxicity and ethical supply chain risks, despite a slightly lower energy density.
decisions.design_action: Verify the volumetric energy density constraints of LFP batteries against the target runtime and weight budget of the vacuum cleaner concept.
